content.intro: This lesson covers Rows, Columns, Values, and Filters as part of PivotTables and PivotCharts. It follows the attached Excel curriculum, with an emphasis on small examples and verification.
content.why_it_matters: Rows, Columns, Values, and Filters supports repeatable analysis by organizing, cleaning, summarizing, or relating data. Preserve the raw source and reconcile a summary back to its input records. Compatibility: Check Microsoft’s function reference for the target Excel version, platform, and update channel. Dynamic-array spill behavior and some newer functions are not available in every legacy installation.

task_acceptance_criteria: The worksheet/workflow uses a clear, labeled source range and explicit assumptions.
The learner records an expected output and independently compares it with the actual result.
